entry.title: Arthur Again
entry.summary:
Author: Saladscream

Rating: ExplicitLanguage: EnglishWords: 10,980Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 12

Summary: In the end, Merlin finds the tuxedo cat sulking under the bed. “Come on, you can’t keep doing this, mate,” Merlin chides as he gently drags the toneless pet from where he is hiding. The soft, plaintive mrow is a jab to Merlin's already aching heart. The yellow eyes are gunky and full of reproach and sorrow, and Merlin can feel the ribs a bit too sharp under the lacklustre fur. He gathers the sickly cat to his chest and holds him, pressing a kiss to the top of his head. “You can’t go on like this. I know you miss him, but you have to eat,” he pleads as the black tail remains motionless. "It's hard enough as it is without—" he cuts himself off and hugs the miserable cat a little closer. There's only one possible way out of this mess and Merlin hates it.
